findings.label: Availability card missing corner ornaments
findings.description: The Availability card in Contact.tsx has the bg-shadow/40 border border-candlelight/20 styling but lacks the four corner ornament divs that every other card in the design system has. Add the corner ornaments for consistency.

findings.label: Skills corner ornaments use inline styles
findings.description: Skills.tsx applies category-specific border colors to corner ornaments using inline style={{ borderColor: category.hex }} instead of using Tailwind classes. This works but is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase which uses only Tailwind utilities. Consider extracting to CSS custom properties or accepting the inline style as necessary for dynamic theming.
